newsitem.title: USA: US Diagnostic settles class actions suit.
newsitem.headline: US Diagnostic settles class actions suit.

text.p: US Diagnostic Inc said Thursday it has agreed to pay $5.875 million to settle shareholder class action lawsuits brought against the company in January.
The company said the various parties to the suits had executed a memorandum of understanding that is subject to certain terms and conditions, including court approval and notice to the class members.
It said the court approval process may take up to 145 days.
The lawsuits were related to the company's recent turmoil after an official linked to the firm pleaded guilty to securities law violations.
US Diagnostics has said the official worked as a consultant and it has ended its relationship with him.
Two of the company's top managers were placed on administrative leave and new officials were installed.
US Diagnostic said the resolution of the lawsuit will free up the company to obtain new financing to restart its program of strategic acquisitions.
